newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Petron delays 85,000-bpd CDU catalyst work to Aug.
newsitem.headline: Petron delays 85,000-bpd CDU catalyst work to Aug.

text.p: Philippine refiner Petron Corp has delayed the shutdown of a 85,000-barrel-per-day (bpd) crude distillation unit (CDU) to August from March as work to regenerate a catalyst has been put back, a company source said on Monday.
"The planned shutdown of the CDU No.2 was only for catalyst regeneration of a 17,000-bpd reformer," the source said. "We checked the catalyst a month ago and found it was still in good condition."
The rescheduled shutdown at the 165,000-bpd refinery at Batangas is expected around August 1-12 but the exact dates have yet to be finalised, he said.
